journal_lines: §aThin scrub. No real timber. Gathered what branches could be found.
§aCame back with sticks. This place does not have trees, properly speaking.
§aWrong biome for this work. Did what I could with what was here.
§aOne decent trunk in a morning's worth of scrub. Took it.
§aLooking for lumber. Finding kindling. Still taking it.
§aDead wood leaning against live wood. Took the dead. Left the other to try.
§aScant canopy. §oSmells like dry soil and old grass, nothing green.§o Scrubland gives what scrubland has.
§aSingle tree where there should have been a stand. Worked it carefully. Didn't waste any.
§aGathered dead branches until the bag was worth carrying. Took a while.
§aNot much here. Came back lighter than planned.
